import csv
import json
import pandas as pd

def load_eurostat_data():
    # Load selected indicators
    selected_indicators = pd.read_csv('outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv')
    selected_indicators = selected_indicators['indicator_id'].tolist()

    # Load Eurostat data
    eurostat_data = pd.read_csv('inputs/eurostat/eurostat_city_values_sample.csv')

    # Filter data for selected indicators
    eurostat_data = eurostat_data[eurostat_data['indicator_id'].isin(selected_indicators)]

    # Pivot the data to long format
    eurostat_long = eurostat_data.melt(id_vars=['city_id', 'city_name', 'year', 'indicator_id'],
                                      value_vars=['value', 'unit'],
                                      var_name='variable',
                                      value_name='value')

    # Pivot to get indicator_name
    indicator_info = eurostat_data[['indicator_id', 'indicator_name']].drop_duplicates()
    eurostat_long = eurostat_long.merge(indicator_info, on='indicator_id', how='left')

    # Separate value and unit
    eurostat_long = eurostat_long.pivot_table(index=['city_id', 'city_name', 'year', 'indicator_id', 'indicator_name'],
                                             columns='variable',
                                             values='value',
                                             aggfunc='first').reset_index()

    # Rename columns
    eurostat_long.columns.name = None
    eurostat_long = eurostat_long.rename(columns={'value': 'value', 'unit': 'unit'})

    # Drop duplicates
    eurostat_long = eurostat_long.drop_duplicates()

    # Save to CSV
    eurostat_long.to_csv('outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv', index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    load_eurostat_data()
</solution_file>
